title: User logs in and reaches the dashboard
description: This verifies that a user can sign in with valid credentials and land on the protected dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard
Verify protected account content is displayed

title: Access the admin dashboard after logging in
description: This test verifies that an administrator can log in and reach the admin dashboard successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin credentials field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the admin login form
Verify the admin dashboard is displayed

title: Logged-in user runs a skin check and sees guidance
description: This verifies that an authenticated user can upload a supported skin image, run analysis, and view the classification and guidance results.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the skin check page
Upload a supported skin image
Start the analysis
Verify a classification result is displayed
Verify guidance is displayed

title: Anonymous visitor explores doctors and opens a provider profile
description: This verifies that an anonymous visitor can browse doctors and review an individual doctor's specialization, availability, and booking information.

steps.description: Navigate to /doctors
Review the list of available doctors
Open a doctor's details
Verify doctor specialization information is displayed
Verify doctor availability and booking information are displayed

title: Add a new provider to the managed list
description: This test verifies that an administrator can create a new provider and see it appear in the managed list.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin credentials field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the admin login form
Open the provider creation form
Fill in the provider name field with Dr. Maya Sen
Select a doctor role
Fill in the specialization field with dermatology
Fill in the phone number field with 5551234567
Select an availability option
Submit the provider form
Verify the new provider appears in the managed list

title: Remove an existing provider from the available list
description: This test verifies that an administrator can delete a provider and no longer see that provider in the available list.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin credentials field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the admin login form
Create a provider for removal
Open the actions for the newly created provider
Remove the provider from the managed list
Verify the provider no longer appears in the available list

title: Doctor list remains usable for browsing
description: This verifies that the doctors page shows an available provider list for browsing before booking decisions are made.

steps.description: Navigate to /doctors
Verify available doctors are displayed

title: Caretaker list remains usable for browsing

steps.description: Navigate to /caretakers
Verify available caretakers and therapists are displayed
